Padding increases scratch footprint by 50%; it may add address-generation cost or worsen cache behavior. Check that every packed store and both consumers stay within the 98,304-byte allocation, including the final K slice and second row half. Run the fixed correctness cases and tolerance checks, then the existing ten validation reports, ten alternating paired controls, promotion gate, and holdout with power source and settings unchanged.
